resources.string: Default packages are for QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, and Qishui. Available controls depend on the music app.

Off by default. Allow the assistant to read new notifications from selected apps when explicitly requested. This is separate from WeChat previews on glasses. Up to 20 notifications stay in memory; an assistant request may send their contents to your configured AI provider.
One exact package name per line. An empty list allows no apps.
